heading.purpose: One per screen, serif italic: the beat a judge reads from the back of the room.

section.purpose: Serif italic section names: Needs your answer, Why we think so, Constellations.

constellation-name.purpose: The event's name on the canvas, serif italic 18px, with its date in the sans under it.

body.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible 18px: evidence text, card bodies, answers.

date-cell.purpose: Tabular 15px slate in the first 7ch of every timetable row.

small-caps.purpose: Band names on the plate, source chips, legends: 12px bold uppercase, 0.08em.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Every authored moment: the switch, the rows' arrival, the sheet, the share.

motion.name: reveal-dots
motion.purpose: After Check now the field's dots fade in left to right (canvas, 1 - 2^(-10t)).

motion.name: reveal-figure
motion.purpose: Each constellation draws its lines along their length and brightens its stars, in reading order.

motion.name: rows-after-figures
motion.purpose: The timetable rows rise after the last figure, only on the render that follows a check.

motion.name: share-leave
motion.purpose: The three payload rows lift off the chart in order.

motion.name: share-arrive
motion.purpose: The rows arrive as what If received; the counter flips once and the strip lights in Glow Amber.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every end state in place; the canvas draws the sky at once.

magnitudeRamp.purpose: Five star sizes from the detector's normalised margin; unknown is the faintest. Shared by the sky plate and the novelty dots.

chartLayout.coordinateSpace: Measured CSS width through ResizeObserver; labels retain their CSS-pixel size.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one amber action on a screen: Check now, Continue, Yes help me, Share with If.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 54px; padding: 10px 18px; background: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); color: var(--ink-on-amber, #0a1021); border: 1px solid var(--amber, #ff4d2e); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #ff4d2e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Every other action: Not now, Cancel, Not this, Keep it on this phone.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 18px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #f2f2e9); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #f2f2e9); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(242 242 233 / 6%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #ff4d2e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Timetable row
components.description: An event as a row: date cell, the detector’s title, the amber arrow, a hairline under it. At 350px and below the wrapping date spans both columns above the title and arrow.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7ch 1fr 24px; column-gap: 14px; align-items: start; width: 100%; padding: 16px 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, #24374f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #24374f); color: var(--ink, #f2f2e9); text-align: left; font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-date { font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding-top: 3px; } .ds-row-title { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-row-arrow { color: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); align-self: center; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(242 242 233 / 6%); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #ff4d2e); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 350px) { .ds-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 24px; row-gap: 6px; } .ds-row-date { grid-column: 1 / -1; white-space: normal; } }

components.name: Source chip
components.description: A source name in small caps above evidence; novelty chips use the outlined pill instead.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); } .ds-chip-outline { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #f2f2e9); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #f2f2e9); }

components.name: Journey card
components.description: A hairline card with no fill; a warning's outline is amber with an amber dot before its serif title.
components.html:
By 30 October

Frost warning for Varsinais-Suomi on the move week

Night frost is forecast from 30 October. Make sure no water is left on in the old flat.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #24374f); border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px; color: var(--ink, #f2f2e9); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card-warning { border-color: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); } .ds-card-due { font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-title { margin: 8px 0 10px; font-family: "Instrument Serif", "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-warning .ds-card-title::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: 0 10px 3px 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Source switch
components.description: An outlined track and a slate thumb; amber when on.
components.html: <button class="ds-switch ds-on" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Mail"></button> <button class="ds-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Photos"></button>
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 6px 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); border-radius: 20px; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 5px; top: 11px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-switch.ds-on::before { border-color: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); } .ds-switch.ds-on::after { transform: translateX(24px); background: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber, #ff4d2e); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Four destinations in slate; the active one in amber with a dot under it.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 6px 16px; background: var(--shell, #16233d); border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, #24374f); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 48px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #a3acbc); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 4px; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-left: -3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber, #ff4d2e); }

narrative.overview: The phone looked at the sky of its own data and found a few bright things. The app is the chart of that sky: every snippet in the window is a star, placed by date and source; an event is a constellation, its signals brightened and joined by hairlines; the months ahead are a plate with the risks drawn on it. It refuses the card stack of equal grey rectangles and the dashboard of tiles. This is an Operate surface: the world lends type, palette, density and one signature move; navigation and controls stay the standard web ones.
keyCharacteristics: One material everywhere: hairline coordinate rules and dots on a fixed magnitude ramp, no fills, no shadows, no gradients.
Two voices: a light italic serif names things (events, constellations, headings); a hyperlegible sans with tabular figures measures them (dates, counts, body).
One amber, for the thing under the eye: the primary action, the selected state, the ringed object, and the counter after a share (in its glow tint).
The sky plate is the only chart on Home; lists stay lists.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks exactly one thing per screen as the thing under the eye. A second amber on the same screen is either the warning outline (by kind) or a mistake.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif italic names; sans measures. A number is never set in the serif; a constellation name is never set in the sans.

dos: Do keep standard web controls and keyboard affordances; the world lends type, palette, density and the sky.
Do keep the outbound counter visible on every screen, including onboarding and settings.
Do keep every number on screen from code: the detector's wording, the contract's dates and margins, the labelled example data.
donts: Don't add fills, shadows or gradients; a surface is the chart.
Don't add a second chart to Home; the sky plate owns the field and lists stay lists.
Don't add If branding; insurers appear by name only on insurance and comparison cards.
